hook.name: LivingCurveHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook implementing a dynamic "weather" system that adjusts LP fees (0.2%–2%) based on rolling buy/sell volume ratios, LP activity, and a health score tracked over 5-minute epochs. Swaps are restricted to the Live phase and gated behind a governance-controlled tradingEnabled flag; liquidity management is restricted to a privileged bootstrapManager.
